items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

ctx.x: Well, who are some of them? Well, I think DeRica. I worked with him a while. I believe. What about DeJalma Gagne?
Yeah, I worked with Gagne. How often did you play with him? Well, whenever we'd get a funeral parade, they'd get them quite often.
